set.body:
When engine is set, .fmri_lm_dispatch_engine is called without strategy,
nchunks, use_fast_path, progress, parallel_voxels, or parallel_chunks
(R/fmrilm.R:734-743 and :814-823). They are accepted and silently dropped. Nothing
warns and nothing documents it. 43 of 191 call sites pass engine=.

Fix: warn naming the ignored arguments. After the redesign this becomes a check
on the compute= spec against the engine's declared capabilities.
set.title: Warn when engine= silently ignores the six compute formals
